result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. While traffic signals are present to control vehicle flow, there is a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals or advanced safety features like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't-walk signals are visible, which can lead to confusion for pedestrians at a signalized intersection.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide two-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the lack of curb extensions and the presence of parked cars near the crossing create visibility challenges for pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the street near the crosswalk obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area could pose a tripping hazard or reduce the visibility of markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the foreground roadway within the crosswalk stripes.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve conspicuity.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide street and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the image near the intersection may block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection, near the parking lot entrance.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively fast vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
